items.text: Leyo yaba yinkatho yesizwe sabantwana bakwaJuda ngezizukulwane zabo; kuze kube semkhawulweni wakwa-Edomi ihlane laseSini ngaseningizimu ekupheleni kogu lwaseningizimu.
Umngcele wabo ongaseningizimu wawusuka ogwini loLwandle Lukasawoti ethekwini elibheke eningizimu.
Waphuma waya ohlangothini lwaseningizimu, waya eMahali-hakrabimi, wadlulela eSini, wenyukela ohlangothini lwaseningizimu eKadeshi Barineya, wadlulela eHezironi, wenyukela e-Adari, wazungeza eKarika.
Wasuka lapho, waya e-Ashimoni, waphuma waya emfuleni waseGibithe; nokuphuma kwalolo gu kwakungaselwandle; lokhu kuyakuba ugu lwenu oluseningizimu.
Umkhawulo wasempumalanga wawuLwandle Lukasawoti, kuze kube sekugcineni kweJordani. Umkhawulo wabo ohlangothini olungasenyakatho wawusuka ethekwini lolwandle ekupheleni kweJordani;
umkhawulo wenyuka waya eBeti Hogila, wadlula ngasenyakatho kweBeti Haraba; intambo ikhuphukele etsheni likaBohani indodana kaRubeni.
Umkhawulo wenyukela eDebhiri usuka esigodini sase-Agori, waya ngasenyakatho malungana neGiligali, engaphambi kommango oya e-Adumimi eseningizimu yoMfula; Ukuphuma kwawo kwakuse-Enrogeli.

Umkhawulo wenyuka waya esigodini sendodana kaHinomu ngaseceleni kwamaJebusi ngaseningizimu; leli yiJerusalema, umkhawulo wenyukela esiqongweni sentaba ephambi kwesigodi sikaHinomu ngasentshonalanga, esisekupheleni kwesigodi samaRefa ngasenyakatho.
Umkhawulo wawususuka esiqongweni sentaba, waya emthonjeni wamanzi aseNefitowa, waphuma waya emizini yasentabeni yase-Efroni; umkhawulo waphuma waya eBahala eliyiKiriyati Jeharimi.
Umkhawulo wasuka eBhahala ngasentshonalanga, waya entabeni yaseSeyiri, wadlulela eceleni kweNtaba iJeharimi eyiKesaloni ngasenyakatho, wehlela eBeti Shemeshi, wadlulela eThimna;
umkhawulo waphuma waya eceleni kwe-Ekroni ngasenyakatho, umkhawulo waphuma waya eSikroni, wadlula entabeni yaseBahala, waphuma waya eJabineyeli; ukuphuma komngcele kwakusolwandle.
Umkhawulo osentshonalanga wawubheke oLwandle Olukhulu nogu lwalo. Lona umkhawulo wabantwana bakwaJuda nxazonke ngezizukulwane zabo.
UKalebi indodana kaJefune wanika uJoshuwa isabelo phakathi kwabantwana bakoJuda, njengesiyalezo sikaJehova kuJoshuwa, umuzi ka-Arba, uyise kaEnaki, eyiHebroni.
UKalebi wawaxosha khona amadodana amathathu ka-Anaki, oSeshayi, no-Ahimani, noTalimayi, amadodana ka-Anaki.
Wasuka lapho, waya kwabakhileyo eDebiri; igama leDebiri laliyiKiriyati Seferi ngaphambili.
Wayesethi uKalebi: “Onqoba iKiriyati-Seferi, alithathe, ngiyakumnika indodakazi yami u-Akisa ibe ngumkami.”
U-Otheniyeli indodana kaKenazi, umfowabo kaKalebi, walithatha, wamnika u-Asa indodakazi yakhe, ibe ngumkakhe.
Esefikile kuye, yamncenga ukuthi acele kuyise isiqephu sezwe; wehla imbongolo yakhe; uKalebi wathi kuye: “Ufunani na?
Wathi: “Ngiphe isibusiso; ngoba unginikile iNingizimu; nginike nemithombo yamanzi. Wamnika imithombo yasenhla nemithombo yaphansi.
Leli yifa lesizwe sabantwana bakwaJuda ngezizukulwane zabo.
Imizi ekude yesizwe sabantwana bakwaJuda ngasogwini oluseningizimu yakwa-Edomi yayiyiKabiseyeli, ne-Edere, neJaguri,
noKina, noDimona, no-Adada,
neKedeshi, neHasori, ne-Itnani,
iSifi, noThelemi, neBeloti,
neHasori, neHadatha, neKeriyoti, neHezironi, eyiHasori,
o-Amamu, noShema, noMolada,
neHasargada, neHeshimoni, neBeti Phalete,
neHazarsual, neBeri Sheba, neBisiyotiya,
uBhaala, no-Iyimi, no-Asem,
ne-Elitoladi, neKesili, neHorma,
neZikilagi, neMadmana, neSansana,
neLebawoti, neSilehimi, ne-Ayini, neRimoni; yonke imizi ingamashumi amabili nesishiyagalolunye nemizana yayo;
nasesigodini i-Eshitawoli, neSoreki, ne-Asna,
neSanowagi, ne-Eganimi, neTaphuwagi, ne-Enami,
noJarimuthi no-Adulamu, noSogo no-Aseka,
neSharaim, ne-Aditayimi, neGedera, neGederothayimi; imizi eyishumi nane nemizana yayo.
ISenani noHadasha neMigdaligadi,
noDileyan, neMispa, noJokiteyeli,
iLakishi neBoskati ne-Egiloni,
neKhabhoni, neLahamamu, neKitlishi,
neGederoti, neBeti Dagoni, neNahama, neMakheda; imizi eyishumi nesithupha nemizana yayo.
ILibina, ne-Etere, ne-Asan,
noJifta, no-Asna, noNesibi,
noKehila, no-Agisibi, noMaresa; imizi eyisishiyagalolunye nemizana yayo.
I-Ekroni namadlelo alo namadlelo alo;
kusukela e-Ekroni kuze kube selwandle, yonke engase-Ashidodi nemizana yayo;
I-Ashidodi namadlelo alo namadlelo alo, neGaza namadlelo alo nemizana yalo, kwaze kwaba semfuleni waseGibithe noLwandle Olukhulu nomkhawulo walo;
Futhi ezintabeni, iSamiri, neJatiri, neSoko,
noDana, neKiriyatsana eyiDebiri,
no-Anabi, no-Estemo, nama-Anim,
neGosheni, neHoloni, neGilo; imizi eyishumi nanye nemizana yayo;
Arab, Duma, Esean,
noJanumu, neBethaphuwagi, ne-Afeka,
neHumta, neKiriyatarba eliyiHebroni, neSiyori; imizi eyisishiyagalolunye nemizana yayo.
IMahoni, iKarmeli, neZifi, neJuta,
neJizreyeli, neJokideyamu, neSanowagi,
iKhayini, iGibeya, neThimna; imizi eyishumi nemizana yayo;
iHalhuli, iBesuri, neGedori,
neMarat, neBetanoti, ne-Elitekoni; imizi eyisithupha nemizana yayo.
IKiriyati Bhali eliyiKiriyati Jeharimi, neRaba; imizi emibili nemizana yayo.
Ehlane, iBetaraba, iMidin, neSekaka,
neNibisani nomuzi kaSawoti ne-Eni Gedi; imizi eyisithupha nemizana yayo.
Kepha amaJebusi akhileyo eJerusalema abantwana bakwaJuda babengenakuwaxosha; kepha amaJebusi ahlala nabantwana bakwaJuda eJerusalema kuze kube namuhla.
